events.text: November Consumer Confidence Index (Conference Board), 10:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Release date per the Conference Board. The index rose 7.5 points to 91.7 in October, up from 84.2 in September.

events.text: Third-quarter GDP (second estimate) and October personal income and spending, including the PCE inflation gauge, 8:30 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Both releases scheduled for the same morning, per the BEA news release schedule.

events.text: Supreme Court hears the challenge to third-country deportations (date to be set).
events.detail: Deportations can continue in the meantime; a decision is expected by summer 2027.

events.text: Senate Democrats vote on their leader for the new majority: Chuck Schumer vs. Chris Van Hollen.
events.detail: Leadership election date per the Washington Post and Los Angeles Times; Schumer says he has the votes.

events.text: Fed interest-rate decision and new economic projections, ending the Dec. 8-9 meeting.
events.detail: Meeting dates per the Fed's FOMC calendar; this meeting includes a Summary of Economic Projections.
Congress must pass funding or another stopgap by then to avoid a partial government shutdown.

events.text: White House hearing on whether to fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook.
events.detail: Cook's lawyer says she will not take part unless NEC Director Kevin Hassett is removed from the panel (Wall Street Journal).

events.text: G20 leaders' summit at Trump National Doral, Miami.
events.detail: Dates per the State Department's media logistics notice; Putin has not said whether he will attend.
